title: Changelog & Updates
footerNote: This is a continuous project. Feel free to contact me for new features or bug reports.

items: Rewrote the Support Guide with full hand-written documentation for every topic, no more auto-generated placeholders.
Guide pages now include step-by-step instructions, real download links, videos, and images pulled directly from the bot resources.
Changelog now supports multiple dated sections so you can track what changed and when.
Changelog notification now shows as a proper modal popup, visible once per session, stored in your browser.
Topbar changelog icon added, click it anytime to re-open the changelog.
Discord custom emoji rendering added to the QRs page (e.g. <:bao:1539473212394442773> now shows as the actual emoji).
Mobile search bar added to the QRs page for better phone usability.
Page transitions smoothed out, reduced the freezing/popping effect when navigating between pages.
Bot API fix: attachments are no longer duplicated in the message text.
Added dedicated Support Guide covering team protocols, work.ink fixes, bin replacements, and crash playbooks.
Added full rendering support for videos, images, and downloadable script cards (.bat, .exe, .zip) in the QRs page.
Added an Easter Egg. Find it!
Optimizations for API. the bot should be faster.
